sequence.verdict: FAILED_VARIANT: NEITHER treatment -- the 43-way one-hot type block NOR the scalar direction x confidence score the published literature uses -- beats its own capacity-matched shuffled control under any model, so what either earns is the panel's calendar and universe, not the events. This closes THIS READ of the LLM-typed rows at 30,690 of 129,983 cells (23.6% coverage); below ~5% coverage the shuffled control has little power, and the next test is typing the panel's own headlines, not another head.

sequence.verdict: ADWIN NEVER FIRED after the mandatory first fit, so the ADWIN arm is one model carried across every test month (max age 13 months). That is a fact about the ERROR STREAM -- at this scale it is stationary to the detector -- and only secondarily about the cadence. Read the stale-vs-fresh IC split, not the refit count: a monthly refit that changes nothing is ceremony, and a detector that cannot see the drift is not evidence there is none.
